posts.title: A Bite of the Forbidden Fruit
posts.description: Where did we leave off last time? In talking about macOS, we discovered many different little things signifying a wider rot. Through that exploration, a few consistent themes emerged. Some of these themes were: don’t mix metaphors, articulate clear directions, and prioritize the human above all. We’ve seen individual symptoms. Time to make it more concrete. Slowly then suddenly, macOS is facing it
